focus: جلسه هجدهم · نشانه‌های حال کامل (just / already / never)

sentences.en: He didn't see this film.
He hasn't seen this film.

sentences.fa: اون تاحالا اين فيلم رو نديده.
sentences.en: He has never seen this film.
I never smoke cigarette.
I have never smoked cigarette.

sentences.fa: من تاحالا اين فيلم رو نديدم.
sentences.en: I have never seen this film.

sentences.fa: پدرم تاحالا براي مهاجرت اقدام نکرده.
sentences.en: My father has never applied for immigration.
I have never gone on a trip alone.

sentences.fa: شوهرم تاحالا برام هديه اي نخريده.
sentences.en: My husband has never bought any gifts for me.
I have never taken a photo here.
Do you ever smoke cigarrate?
Have you ever smoked cigarrate?
Have you ever broken your leg?
Has your mother ever hit you?
Have you ever danced with a girl?
Has your father ever eaten out?
I have never eaten out.

sentences.fa: تاحالا 7 تا کشور رو ديده. در شهر پايتخت مونده. تاحالا قبلا اروپا رو نديده.
sentences.en: He has already seen 7 countries. He has stayed in the capital city. He has never seen the Europe before.
Has he ever seen the Europe?

sentences.fa: او تاحالا خيلي جاها رو ديده.
sentences.en: He has already seen a lot of places.
How many places has he seen so far?

sentences.fa: او چيزهاي زيادي رو انجام داده.
sentences.en: He has done a lot of things.
What has he done?
What did he do?
What have you done?
What did you do last night?
The tour hasn't finished.
The class hasn't finished.
The meeting hasn't finished.
Has the meeting finished?
Has the class finished?
The class has just finished.

sentences.fa: من تاحالا دوتا منشي استخدام کردم.
sentences.en: I have already employed 2 secretaries.
How many secretaries have you employed so far?
I have never employed any secretories.
Have you ever employed any secretories?

proverb.en: He laughs best, who laughs last.
